# Data license

Released AMOS ontology-derived tables are provided under the Creative Commons

CHMO content is used under CC BY 4.0. ENVO content is available under CC0.
AMOS source metadata remains attributable to its original publishers and the
U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. This repository does not redistribute
AMOS-hosted PDFs or full extracted document text.

ECOTOX lifestage is a separate domain. Source material retains the terms and
attribution in [the installed ECOTOX attribution file](ECOTOX-ATTRIBUTION.md).
UBERON and AMPHX source content is CC BY 3.0; PO, FOODON, NVS S11 and Life Stages
content is CC BY 4.0. New mapping contributions are CC BY 4.0. ECOTOX vocabulary
and aggregate facts remain attributed to EPA; no licence is claimed for source
study documents, which are not included. The AMOS statement above does not
replace those terms. Unknown reviewer identities and dates remain unknown.
